runtime.pin_policy: The runner must receive an explicit Pdfium shared library and its SHA-256; system-library discovery or an unhash-pinned runtime is not accepted for a golden artifact. CI executes the runtime job only when both repository variables are configured.

golden_policy: Add a Pdfium-rendered PNG only after the Pdfium runtime/API build is pinned in CI. Compare dimensions and pixels at the same target width; do not compare Pdfium output against a Poppler golden as if they were pixel-identical.
